title: Junior Scientist
body:
The Junior Scientist (written in game as Jr. Scientist) is a NPC located on Finlay Island. She is a budding astronomer.

Description

The Junior Scientist can be found by taking the right turn just before crossing the drawbridge, then taking a left turn before crossing the small arched bridge leading to the northern part of Finlay Island. There is a small rock ledge that can be climbed up to reach the Junior Scientist.

Talking to the Junior Scientist will cause her to explain that she is "... a scientist! Well... Future scientist!" She explains that she and Giggles (the non-interactible rat standing beside her) are out looking for meteor showers. Should the player ask to know when the next meteor is coming, she will "ask Giggles what he thinks" before demanding the player pay $3,500. If the player pays up, she will give the number of minutes before the next meteor spawns. If the player declines, she will express her disappointment, saying that she "wanted a new telescope".

Dialog

Interacting with the Junior Scientist:

"Hello I'm a scientist! Well... Future scientist! I love science, don't you? Me and Giggles are looking out for a meteor shower!"
  • If the player selects "Cool..?": Dialog ends
  • If the player selects "When's the next meteor?":
    "Hmmm, let me ask Giggles what he thinks... We don't tell strangers right away! *snickers* OK! WE HAVE CAME TO THE DECISION. $3,500 AND I'LL TELL YOU"
  • If the player selects "No thanks":
    "Aww... I wanted a new telescope..."
  • If the player selects "Deal":
    "AWWW TYSM!!! You are so sweet. The next meteor will be in ~[number] minutes!"
    Player loses $3,500.
